Q1_tolerance.question: every case within 10% of linear theory?

Q2_refinement.question: does the error fall under refinement (cpd 8 -> 20)?

Q3_sensitivity.question: how much do A/H and cs/sqrt(gH) move the measured frequency?

figures.name: fig1_modal_record.png
figures.caption: Baseline modal amplitude record a1(t) against the linear-theory oscillation A cos(omega1 t); the phase drift over three periods is the frequency error, the envelope decay is numerical damping.

figures.name: fig2_dispersion.png
figures.caption: Left: measured first-mode frequency vs H/L on top of the linear dispersion curve; right: the same points as an error against the 10% mission tolerance.

figures.name: fig3_ladder.png
figures.caption: Frequency error against particle spacing for cells-per-depth 8/12/16/20; the coarse end is dominated by the topmost-particle gauge quantisation, the fine end plateaus near 1%.

figures.name: fig4_sensitivity.png
figures.caption: One-at-a-time sensitivity of the measured frequency to the released amplitude A/H and to the artificial sound speed cs/sqrt(gH).

figures.name: fig5_fields.png
figures.caption: Baseline field frames: left, particle speed |u| at a quarter of the first-mode period; right, the space-time free-surface elevation, whose antinode is at the walls and node at mid-length (mode 1).
